translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

book.name: YOHANE
book.title: Yohane Yeng Yesuac Siduc Gombung Ohoec

content: Uameme yohockang wisickeu Gariraia bangecfu Kana taonnu memeturang fingerec. Nga Yesuac nonggea ihai kecmanu
Yesu nga medacfora momoc heitaiyunugec.
Nga yeni waingngina kpac anu nonggeango Yesu edeec, “Waingngina kpac ande.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Ngac, neac wiac imoc geac mi ande, nasona mi hadacngoc.”
Ifi deu nonggeango uamedac edeyunuec, “Yeng wiac monggac edengunuu ngeni imoc sasawa tofohobisia.”
Anu yudangic yeni dzuac dzuac fakangina modacma enang dokuyagoc faigec tacande. Imocac amma imohaingoc enang hocngo memea 6 faigec tarec. Enang mocgu mocgu imoc 100 lita, ifingo tackenec.
Nga Yesungo uamedac yofi edeyunuec, “Ngeni doku fima enannu kpakegec kemema wakeu.” ifi deu yeni doku figec kemema wakedarec.
Figec wakeu yeng yofi edeyunuec, “Ngeni yaguc fima imoc yakagarenggaru mekenggec.” Ifi deu fima mekenggec.
Mekemmagec dokungo waing anu yakagarengo imoc nehemma waing dahacnac dema obohou uamedac doku fima mekenggec, yenengsac negenggec. Ifi nehemma yakagarengo memeturangngic, ye deu haec.
Hau edeec, “Fakanina yofi fede, hanahema waing gombunga ngic gumecyununi nekecma ubasufu anggec waing songea kpac gumecyunuandimbe. Anu geng ine waing gombunga mesufuna tacdacac yaguc meficgenec.”
Yesungo Gariraia bangecfu Kana taonnu kecma negensinggegecdeac faka kuhagoc imoc hanahema meec. Mema kuc nga kibikperagia ifi mekperagiu medacfora yeneng imoc hemma ye negensinggegec.
Kecgec wisickeu Yesu nga nonggo munafora amma medacfora yenahafoc Kafanaung taonnu kemema ihai wenac goa kecgec.
Kecgec yudangic yeneac makekenggac naso wegene hau Yesungo Yerusareng taonnu enec.
Emma henu ngic yeneng womonggac oda manau ramaburumaka nga kebesacneng faigec nga goa tatacnginau tacma hiedzo emekecmagec Yesungo yenenec.

Yenemma indzuru mong mudze mudzea mema imocngo ngic sasawa ramaburumakanginagoc womonnunac yunukisang ayemmeu kemegec. Kememagec ngic hiedzo emekecgec, yeneac dzongina megigi amma tebongina heimerenec.
Heimeremma ngic kebesacneng suegec, yeni yofi edeyunuec, “Ngeni wiacngina imoc meickegec! Ngeni Mannaac ama anggec emekpesi ama mi ambeso.”
Faka imoc fingeru medacfora yeneng yoac mong oho ohoya feec, imoc negensigec,

content.text: “Geac amaac amma herenango gerec dzema dzendandannuude.” (Mitiyegec 69:9)

content: Amma yudangic yeneng meremma edegec, “Ge faka imoc andanggac noc faka kuhagoc mena hemma negensinggenide?”
Ifi degec Yesungo meremma yofi edeyunuec, “Ngeni womong yomoc hembarackegec ni uameme harebecfu imoc miacbade.”
Ifi deu yudangic yeneng degec, “Ngic yeneng womong yomoc kifa 46 mekecma medzickegec. Anu geng uameme harebecfusac naric miacnade me?”
Yesungo ine yengena sebiaac womonnu yoac heima deec.
Kecma homecfunac megboriu yaru medacfora yeneng Yesungo yoac ifi deec, imoc negensigec. Negensima mitikibiu yoac oho ohoya fede nga Yesuac yoac momoc negensinggegec.
Anu Yesungo Yerusarennu makekenggac hombang naso femanu ihai kecma faka kuhagoc meu ngicngac homacngo hemma yeac kpara negensinggegec.
Nga Yesu yengenaoc ngicngac haifakangina hentegecdarecac amma ubakeraha mong mi edeyunuec.
Imoc yofiac, ye yengenaoc ngic yeneac ubaherenginau wiac sasawa fede, imoc negenecac ngic monggac haniaac ngic mong mi kpesimiec.
